The '''Shenio system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Kalamith sector/Legends|Kalamith sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] company [[Shenio Mining]].<ref name="True Colors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Shenio system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square P-5.<ref name="TEA" />
